title: Session errors
sqlTemplate: select _timestamp, session_id, view_id, type, error_type, error_source_type, error_source, error_message, service, env, version from _rumdata where session_id = {{session_id}} and type = 'error' order by _timestamp asc limit 100
emptyDataSemantics: No matching records -> an empty result set (zero rows), not an error.
